title: GPS, Geo-tagging & Geo-tracking
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 2 Week 2 Study sheet pp.9-18

scenes.t: GPS stands for Global Positioning System. GPS helps us find our location. GPS means: where am I?
There are satellites flying high up in space. Your phone or car talks to the satellites, and they tell it: you are right here!
Then your device shows you a map and helps you find the way. We can use GPS to find our school on a map.
Geo-tagging means adding location information to a photo. For example, a photo tagged: Cairo, Egypt.
Geo-tracking means following the location of a moving person or object. For example, parents can track a school bus on a map.
Remember: geo-tagging is one place. Geo-tracking is movement.
To share a location with Google Maps: open Google Maps, search for the place, and choose Share.
Then copy the link, and send it to others using an app.
